title: CLIP THE BIAS: HOW USEFUL IS BALANCING DATA IN MULTIMODAL LEARNING?
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. The study focuses on mitigating representation and association biases in contrastive language-image models, specifically related to perceived gender, occupations, and skin tone.
findings: The paper does not analyze or report findings related to religion or faith.
